_meta.description: Hand-verified, mechanically-safe find/replace rules applied by both the PowerShell CLI (Update-ObsoleteApis.ps1) and the C# ApiMigrator.Core engine used by the GUI. Compiled from data/charts/*.xml|*.json via ApiMigrator.Cli compile-rules. Regex syntax is .NET System.Text.RegularExpressions. Optional ensureUsings / requiresSubstring / enabled:false / postEnsureUsings as documented in data/charts/README.md.
_meta.notes: Source of truth for edits: data/charts/ (compile-rules). Do not hand-edit this JSON except via compile.

_addAction.note: AddActionFixer maps obsolete string AddAction overloads to AddAction(new InventoryAction { … }) when first arg is string/Name: and remaining args map to known InventoryAction fields. Classic (Name,Key,FireOnActor,Display,Command) vs modern (Name,Display,Command,…) detected by 2nd positional char vs string. Skips Override (no InventoryAction field) while still consuming its positional arg. Named+positional mixes skip already-filled slots. CS8209 `_ = E.AddAction(...)` void discards are stripped. InventoryActionsXmlFixer (mod-scoped, runs first): literal Name/Display/Command/Key → AddXMLAction("Name") + InventoryActions.xml overlay; same-file `string cmd = "…"` Command fields are resolved.

_addReplacerExpr.note: ReplaceBuilder.AddReplacer: dump's generic obsolete message is now 'Decorate a valid method with VariableReplacer' (delegate/method-group forms). Value forms still → SetArgument (same arg order: Key/Alias, Value/Argument). Curated autofix: literal+literal, literal+exprWithDotOrCall, and literal+ternary(? :) → SetArgument. Bare identifiers stay advice-only (string local vs Replacer method group).

_appendReputationDescription.note: AppendReputationDescriptionFixer (NOT curated regex): StringBuilder local = new()/new StringBuilder(); … AppendReputationDescription(local) → using TextBuilder local = TextBuilder.Get();. Early-outs unless AppendReputationDescription is present — avoids ReDoS that hung Update-ObsoleteApis.ps1 on large mods. Ensures using XRL.World.Text.

_bodiesAnatomy.note: Bodies.xml anatomy compat: Type="Flipper" → Type="Fin" (vanilla BodyPartType; Fish uses Fin for lateral swimming limbs). Laterality="Middle" → "Mid" (Laterality.GetCode; vanilla uses Mid / Right Mid / Left Mid) — scoped to Laterality= attrs only.

_capitalizeInstance.note: CapitalizeFixer: simple recv.Capitalize()/Capitalize(bool) → Translator.InitUpper(recv). Curated regex still covers Extensions.Capitalize( and ColorUtility.CapitalizeExceptFormatting(. Chained receivers (Grammar.Cardinal(n).Capitalize()) stay advice-only.

_countMethodGroup.note: Not expressed as regex rules here — balanced-paren LINQ tails and IEnumerable-typed locals need CountMethodGroupFixer (C#) / Repair-CountMethodGroups (Update-ObsoleteApis.ps1). Auto-fix: .Where(...).Count > N → .Count(); IEnumerable<T> xs; xs.Count > N → xs.Count(). Excluded: list.Count, dict.Count, ToList().Count, ICollection/IList/IReadOnlyList Count properties, ambiguous var/foo.Count.

_drankOverride.note: DrankOverrideFixer is last-resort signature-only: Drank(..., StringBuilder Message, ...) → TextBuilder on leftover vanilla liquid patches (LiquidBlood, …). Own BaseLiquid.Drank is converted by LiquidDrankToPartFixer (MessageOnDrink / *OnDrink part) and is not bumped. PreferXML.Drank on own BaseLiquid; PreferHarmonyPatch.Drank on vanilla liquid types; BaseLiquidPart.Drank is the part pipeline and is not flagged.

_finalRenderOverride.note: FinalRenderOverrideFixer: override bool FinalRender(RenderEvent E, bool Alt) → FinalRender(RenderEvent E) only when Alt is unreferenced in the body. PreferHarmonyPatch.FinalRender advice still reported.

_gameTextCallSites.note: GameTextCallSiteFixer (Apply): high-confidence — MessageQueue/Popup $"{go.t()} {isOrAre|hasOrHave} …" → =subject.the.name= =subject.verb:…=; $"{go.its} …"; (x => x.an()) → =object.a.name=; simple DidX/XDidY("verb"[, extra][, EndMark "!"] ) / DidXToY / XDidYToZ → EmitMessage (trailing null/bool/color/"&R"/ParentObject defaults ignored). Receiver chains (ParentObject.Physics.DidX, Messaging.XDidY) are included in the replace span so they are not left as Physics."=…". recv.Poss("word") + "…" → =subject.poss:word=; recv.GetVerb("are") → =object.verb:are=; Grammar.InitLowerIfArticle(expr) → =text|initLowerIfArticle=; GameObject.a/the/its/It/itself/Is → =object.*= StartReplace (skips case Keys.A / assignments); The/the + DisplayName/DisplayNameOnly concat collapsed to =object.The.name=; Popup.ShowYesNoCancel(target itself) → !TargetSelfConfirm(). Ensures using XRL.World.Text and using XRL (StartReplace extension) when the file is not already namespace XRL.*. Concatenated Extra / GameObject.Does stay dump + Ollama suggest / ManualAdvice.

_genotypesXml.note: GenotypesXmlFixer (Apply): strip unused Load= on genotype (GenotypeFactory.LoadGenotypeNode never parses Load; merge is same-Name redeclare).

_getDisplayNameArgs.note: GetDisplayNameArgFixer (Apply): CS1739 GetDisplayName(WithAnnotations: bool) → Annotations: (live BaseMutation is Direct/Base/Annotations/Variant). Named-arg only — do not rewrite GetDisplayName(false) (now Direct).

_harmonyDynamicPatch.note: HarmonyDynamicPatchFixer + RemovedGameApiFixer (data/removed_game_apis.json). Removed game types (SifrahGame, PsychicCombatSifrah, SocialSifrah, HackingGame, …) are not [Obsolete] — they are gone, so typeof() is CS0246 and PatchAll can stall. Autofix: [HarmonyPatch(typeof(T), "M")] → [HarmonyPatch] + Prepare() => TargetMethod() != null + TargetMethod() { AccessTools.TypeByName(fqn); AccessTools.Method(t, "M"); }. Options.Sifrah*/AnySifrah if-blocks stripped (vanilla Lovesick/Domination no longer call minigames). Leftover type identifiers report RemovedType.*; never glob *Sifrah* (SpringSifrah is a mod).

_liquidCsToXml.note: LiquidCsToXmlFixer (mod-scoped): [IsLiquid] / override IsLiquid / ctor FlameTemperature= / VaporTemperature= / … literals, GetName/GetSmeared*/GetColor/GetColors (Colors field or LiquidBlood.Colors → rK), GetValuePerDram, simple StainElements, Blood-like render methods → Liquids.xml (Name = ctor slug, class, fields, <render> when extractable else empty <render />) and strip those C# sites. MergeNamedChildren then MergeMissingInner (never overwrite existing values; empty <render /> replaced when incoming has children). Drink behavior is LiquidDrankToPartFixer. PreferXML.LiquidProperties advice remains if a non-literal assignment is left.

_liquidXmlAdvice.note: LiquidXmlAdviceScanner (report-only, C# files only): FlameTemperature/VaporTemperature/Cleansing/Slippery*/ConsiderDangerous*/… assignments → PreferXML.LiquidProperties with Liquids.xml field list. Not run on XML — object Physics Weight= / population Weight= are not liquid fields. LiquidBlood.Colors/ID → PreferXML.LiquidBlood; LiquidWarmStatic.ApplyRandomEffectTo/GlitchObject/GlitchZone/ID → PreferXML.LiquidWarmStatic (BaseGlitchPart / GlitchOn* / LiquidID.WarmStatic); light CS0118 namespace-vs-type when a using imports a namespace ending in Telepathy/etc.

_liquidXmlRender.note: LiquidXmlFixer (Apply) + LiquidXmlRenderAdviceScanner (report-only). Quiet Age learnings: (1) BaseLiquid C# must be namespace XRL.Liquids for Liquids.xml <class> ResolveType; (2) liquids with <class> missing <render> → insert <render /> (Part.Class null → BaseLiquid.Initialize NRE); merge-only overlays without <class> inherit vanilla render and are not flagged; (3) default-render colorText/colorTile/colorDetail → baseColorText/baseColorTile/baseColorDetail (attrs + direct children; never RenderSecondTo* parts); (4) BrighterWithVolume/LightLevel on <render>/default part → move onto <part Name="Glows"> when safe, else report PreferXML.LiquidRender.MisplacedGlow.

_mutationEntryDisplayName.note: NOT a curated regex — MutationEntry.DisplayName → Name (stable ID) OR GetDisplayName() (UI). Ambiguous; stays needsManual. ManualAdvice.MutationEntryDisplayNameAdvice enriches remaining hits. Callers often pass XML DisplayName text, not Name.

_mutationsXml.note:
MutationsXmlFixer (Apply): strip unused Load= on mutations/category/mutation (merge is same-Name redeclare); strip unused Code= on mutation; Description= attr→child

…

; ExludeFromPool→ExcludeFromPool typo. Confirmed vs MutationFactory/MutationEntry/IPartEntry.

_namingXml.note: NamingXmlFixer (Apply): template Name *Var*→=var= (first letter lower); templatevar Name PascalCase→camelCase; strip unused Load= on templatevar. Confirmed vs XRL.Names.NameStyles XmlDataHelper deprecation messages.

_objectBlueprintXml.note: ObjectBlueprintXmlFixer (Apply): inventoryobject Name→Blueprint; Wire Material= strip; Projectile RequiresPhaseMatch= strip; Examiner AlternateDisplayName= strip; MutationOnEquip ClassName→Mutation (+ Variant strip); mutation Name Compat/Class renames (Compat.xml FreezingHands→FreezingRay/FlamingHands→FlamingRay/… plus display→Class Sleep Gas Generation→SleepGasGeneration, Nerve Poppy→Analgesia, Double-muscled→HeightenedStrength, …); Compat blueprint Name/Inherits renames (Doru→Tam, JoppaZealot→VillageZeroConvert, …); mutation Value=*delete→removemutation; obsolete part attrs (MeleeWeapon.RenderString/SecondaryStat→Stat, Corpse.BodyDrop/InventoryDrop, Brain.IgnoreCombat, Physics.Occluding, acegiak_Seed.Chance); MeleeWeapon ElementalDamage/Element→ElementalDamage part; role→Role tag (drop if Role tag exists); Comwmerce→Commerce; Name= whitespace trim; 2nd AnimatedMaterialGeneric→AnimatedMaterialGenericAlternate; duplicate named part/tag merge later-wins (CyberneticsHasImplants joins Implants). Does not invent Mutations.xml entries for removed classes (FattyHump/HeightenedSmell) — ManualAdvice notes ExcludeFromPool overlay. BlueprintTypeNamespaceFixer also splits trailing IPart after helpers into XRL.World.Parts.

_ollamaLeftovers.note: OllamaLeftoverSuggester: leftover DidX Extra concatenations, GameObject.Does, and other NeedsManual hits after curated autofix. The model MUST emit a C# replacement (skip=true only if already current-API). Hedged skip=true with a safe C# replacement is unskipped; advisory prose (You should / PreferXML essays) is rejected. --apply / GUI Apply writes unique-original-line hits (GUI Apply uses high+medium). Default host localhost:11434. Optional cloud: --cloud / GUI checkbox → https://ollama.com with Authorization Bearer (OLLAMA_API_KEY or --api-key / GUI PasswordBox). Free-tier catalog (CloudModelProfiles, seeded first): gemma4:31b (multimodal 256K), gpt-oss:120b (frontier MoE), gpt-oss:20b (default leftover — fast code/JSON), nemotron-3-nano:30b / super / ultra (agentic 1M). Direct cloud strips trailing -cloud; local proxy keeps *-cloud after ollama signin / ollama pull. Probe GET /api/tags then MergeCloudCatalog; Chat POST /api/chat with format=json, retry without JSON if the model rejects it, fall back to /api/generate. ResolveModel keeps explicit gpt-oss:20b vs :120b (no bare-name collapse). Never writes [Obsolete] or pragma warning disable.

_overridePreference.note: OverridePreferenceScanner / Find-OverridePreferenceHits + ManualAdvice. When a mod extends game/vanilla behavior or data via C# override: (1) PreferXML — MutationEntries DisplayName/Type, Liquids.xml vs IsLiquid, own BaseLiquid.Drank → OnDrink/MessageOnDrink, InventoryActions, blueprints (DataManager overlay / Load=Merge / same-Name redeclare); (2) PreferHarmonyPatch — safer Prefix/Postfix for Register/FireEvent/HandleEvent/Render/FinalRender/vanilla-liquid Drank/… on concrete vanilla types (Stomach, Brain, LiquidBlood, …); (3) C# override only when there is no other option. WantEvent/HandleEvent/Register/FireEvent/Drank on the mod’s own IPart/Effect/BaseMutation/BaseLiquidPart/*Part/*Effect subclasses are the part event pipeline and are not flagged. Do not add [Obsolete] for CS0672. Carve-out: in-place API body fixes inside mod methods are fine. Simple Register bodies may get last-resort signature bump under Apply; complex overrides are never auto-deleted.

_registerOverride.note: RegisterOverrideFixer is last-resort Apply-time only for simple Register(GameObject) bodies that solely call Object.RegisterPartEvent/UnregisterPartEvent(this, …) and optional base.Register(Object). PreferHarmonyPatch still prefers Harmony Prefix/Postfix when replacing a concrete vanilla type; IPart/Effect/BaseMutation Register is the part pipeline and is not flagged. Complex FireEvent-heavy / multi-object registration stays advice-only. Never adds [Obsolete]; never deletes overrides.

_reverseTranslateBit.note: ReverseTranslateBitFixer: BitType.ReverseTranslateBit/ReverseCharTranslateBit → FetchBitByCode. Auto only with clear cues — string/+= / =="?" / BitCost → BitID.ToString(); ColorString/{{ / DisplayColor → DisplayColor; ReverseChar always BitID char. Ambiguous sites stay advice (obsolete msg says .ID; live field is BitID).

_showOptionList.note: Not a curated regex — ShowOptionListFixer maps ShowOptionList/Async → PickOption/Async with named args when positional+named args parse cleanly (Managed signature order). Unmappable calls stay advice-only (ManualAdvice PickOption shape). Never rewrite when unknown named args appear.

_statShifter.note: NOT a curated regex. GameObject.ApplyStatShift/UnapplyStatShift → IPart/Effect StatShifter.SetStatShift / RemoveStatShift|RemoveStatShifts. Receiver moves off GameObject; Unapply drops Amount (GUID-tracked). Flagged needsManual in obsolete_api_dump.json; ManualAdvice.StatShifterAdvice enriches remaining hits.

_statisticCtor.note: StatisticCtorFixer (mod-scoped): CS1729 5-arg new Statistic(name, min, max, value, owner) or (name, displayName, min, max, value) → new Statistic(StatisticBlueprint.TryGet(...) ? bp : new StatisticBlueprint { … }) { Owner, BaseValue } plus Statistics.xml overlay. Ensures using XRL.Blueprints. Name must be a string literal.

_subtypesXml.note: SubtypesXmlFixer (Apply): strip unused Load= on class/category/subtype/skills/reputations/savemodifiers; strip Code= on subtype; class DisplayName→ChargenTitle (strip if ChargenTitle set); strip Class=/Tile= on class only; Foreground=/ForegroundColor=→DetailColor when missing else strip; wrap root orphan <subtype> under <class ID=Callings> or expand preceding empty/self-closing class. Confirmed vs SubtypeFactory XMLNodes (root only accepts class).

_textBuilderHalfMigration.note: TextBuilderCsFixer (Apply) + TextBuilderHalfMigrationScanner (leftovers). After Event.NewStringBuilder → TextBuilder.Get: Event.FinalizeString(tb) → tb.ToString() (CS1503); tb.AppendSigned(n) → Append(n, true); tb.AppendSigned(n, "rules") → AppendModifier; AddsRep.AppendDescription 7-arg → (TB, Value, Faction, SignedRules) with Value/Faction swap. Locals still passed to AppendName/Substitute (StringBuilder APIs) are reverted to new StringBuilder(). Scanner still reports AppendArmor/PV/Damage/Attribute and leftover DefaultDisplayOrder.

_things.note: ThingsFixer: Extensions.Things(num, what[, plural]) / recv.Things(what[, plural]) → _T("…", "=number.things:…=").SetArgument("number", num).ToString() when what (and optional plural) are string literals (GameText.StartReplace same token is fine for non-localized UI). Non-literal nouns stay advice-only. Do not bake markup/color breaks into the noun token — wrap after. Double/Single → cast/round to long for SetArgument (replacer is Int32/Int64).

_tryGetParser.note: NOT obsolete — CS0103. Bare TryGetParser(out IValueParser<T>) must be IValueParser.TryGetParser (static on XRL.Serialization.Parsers.IValueParser; using is not enough without type qualifier). PreLang used TryGetAttributeParser; Lang builds use IValueParser.Add + IValueParser.TryGetParser. Seen in Choose Your Body Plan Lang/Startup.cs GetParser<T>().

_variableReplacerContext.note: VariableReplacerFixer (Apply) + curated rule: [VariableReplacer|VariableObjectReplacer] DelegateContext Context → VariableContext Context. [VariableObjectReplacer(…)] → [VariableReplacer(…, Capitalization = true)]. When the body uses Context.Target / Context.Pronouns, add GameObject Object and rewrite to Object / Object.GetPronounProvider() (vanilla GameObjectReplacers pattern). ConversationDelegate DelegateContext is left alone. Context.Explicit (GenderedNoun) stays manual.

_worldsXml.note: WorldsXmlAdviceScanner (report-only) + WorldsXmlFixer (safe cell DisableForcedConnections strip). Player.log XmlDataHelper: (1) zone Load create conflicts — flag <zone without Load= under cell Load=Merge|Replace; never autofix Merge vs Replace (Bethesda Susa landmark overlay example in ManualAdvice.WorldsZoneLoadAdvice); (2) unexpected cell-level <builder> — report only, never auto-delete (builders/music belong on zones / <music>); (3) DisableForcedConnections on <cell> — Fixer removes (zone-only attr). Dual_Wield_*→Multiweapon_*, *Wares→GenericInventoryRestocker, Calendar.get*→Get*, AddReplacer→SetArgument, AddAction Override skip, ColorUtility/HistoricEvent enabled:false remain curated.

rules.name: Event.NewStringBuilder -> TextBuilder.Get
rules.note: From prior mod-fix work; Event.NewStringBuilder was removed in favor of the pooled TextBuilder.Get() factory. Always ensure using XRL.World.Text; TextBuilder is not in XRL.World. TextBuilderCsFixer reverts Get() to new StringBuilder() when the local is still passed to AppendName/Substitute.

rules.name: XRL.World.TextBuilder -> TextBuilder (wrong FQN)
rules.note: Common mistaken fully-qualified name after NewStringBuilder migration; the type lives in XRL.World.Text, not XRL.World. Does not match the correct XRL.World.Text.TextBuilder form.

rules.name: StringBuilder x = TextBuilder.Get -> TextBuilder x = TextBuilder.Get
rules.note: TextBuilder is not a StringBuilder subclass; leftover typed locals from Event.NewStringBuilder migrations must be retargeted.

rules.name: Grammar.Cardinal -> Translator.Cardinal
rules.note: Safe rename — Translator.Cardinal(int/long) matches Grammar.Cardinal signatures. Prefer embedding count in GameText (`=amount.things:dram=` / `=liquid.cardinal.drams.of.liquid#amount=`) when the surrounding sentence is already a StartReplace/EmitMessage template.

rules.name: Grammar.InitCap -> Translator.InitUpper
rules.note: Defaults to culture-aware InitUpper; switch to Translator.InitUpperInvariant by hand if invariant casing is required.

rules.name: pBrain -> Brain
rules.note: Old GameObject backing-field-style property; live API is Brain. Member-access only (\.pBrain) — bare identifier locals/params named pBrain are NOT rewritten (2026-08 unsafe-autofix audit).

rules.name: Brain.pPhysics -> ParentObject.Physics
rules.note: Brain.pPhysics is obsolete ('use pPhysics on parent object'); Brain has no Physics field. Must run before the general .pPhysics rule. Matches ParentBrain.pPhysics as well (lookbehind is Brain).

rules.name: Brain._pPhysics -> ParentObject.Physics
rules.note: Same as Brain.pPhysics; underscore alias.

rules.name: .pPhysics -> .Physics
rules.note: GameObject field is Physics; member-access only (does not rename locals named pPhysics).

rules.name: .pRender -> .Render
rules.note: GameObject field is Render; member-access only (does not rename locals named pRender).

rules.name: GameObject.create -> Create
rules.note: Qualified GameObject.create only — avoids ScreenBuffer.create and other non-obsolete create helpers.

rules.name: Calendar.getMonth -> Calendar.GetMonth
rules.note: PascalCase rename; GetMonth is the live API.

rules.name: Calendar.getYear -> Calendar.GetYear
rules.note: PascalCase rename; GetYear is the live API.

rules.name: Calendar.getTime -> Calendar.GetTime
rules.note: PascalCase rename for all overloads (getTime()/getTime(zoneID)/getTime(int) → GetTime(...)).

rules.name: Calendar.getDay -> Calendar.GetDay
rules.note: PascalCase rename; GetDay is the live callable API. Do NOT auto-rewrite GetDay() → =time.day= (too broad — computation/UI still need GetDay). Messaging/Popup/journal may hand-migrate to =time.day= (see dump ManualAdvice).

rules.name: Reputation.get -> Reputation.Get
rules.note: PascalCase rename. Dump searchPattern tightened to Reputation.get( (was .get( — HotkeySpread.get false positive).

rules.name: Reputation.set -> Reputation.Set
rules.note: PascalCase rename.

rules.name: Reputation.modify -> Reputation.Modify
rules.note: PascalCase rename.

rules.name: Factions.get -> Factions.Get
rules.note: PascalCase rename; dump pattern already Factions.get(.

rules.name: Location2D.get -> Location2D.Get
rules.note: PascalCase rename.

rules.name: [VariableReplacer] DelegateContext Context -> VariableContext Context
rules.note: Scoped to the method signature immediately below a [VariableReplacer] or [VariableObjectReplacer] attribute; DelegateContext used elsewhere (e.g. ConversationDelegates) is a different, still-current type and is left untouched. VariableReplacerFixer then rewrites VariableObjectReplacer → VariableReplacer(Capitalization=true) and adds GameObject Object when the body uses Context.Target/Pronouns.

rules.name: ReplaceBuilder.AddReplacer(str,str) -> SetArgument
rules.note: Only rewrites the literal-string/literal-string overload; delegate-based AddReplacer(key, MethodRef) calls are left for manual [VariableReplacer] conversion.

rules.name: ReplaceBuilder.AddReplacer(str,expr) -> SetArgument
rules.note: Second arg must contain '.' or '(' (e.g. Opp.its, x.ToString(), ParentObject.DisplayName) so bare Replacer method-group identifiers are not rewritten. Run after the literal+literal rule.

rules.name: ReplaceBuilder.AddReplacer(str,ternary) -> SetArgument
rules.note: Ternary value expressions (e.g. Foil ? " (F)" : null) are always the string Value overload, never a Replacer method group. Same arg order as SetArgument(Alias, Argument). Run after literal+literal and str,expr rules. Does not match commas outside the second arg (keep ternaries simple or hand-fix).

rules.name: LiquidXxx.ID -> LiquidID.Xxx
rules.note: Static LiquidXxx.ID field → LiquidID.Xxx (WarmStatic/Salt/Blood/Water/…). Method calls ApplyRandomEffectTo/GlitchObject/GlitchZone stay PreferXML.LiquidWarmStatic advice (BaseGlitchPart).

rules.name: ReplaceBuilder.AddObject(obj,alias,silent) -> SetArgument(alias,obj,silent)
rules.note: 3-arg aliased form (Object, Alias, Silent). Argument order swaps: AddObject(Object, Alias) -> SetArgument(Alias, Object). Confidence signal earlier in SAME statement (lookbehind stops at ';'): StartReplace(/_T(/ReplaceBuilder/EmitMessage/GameText .Start("… — NOT bare .Start() (Thread/History/Stopwatch) and NOT empty .Start(). chains (2026-08 unsafe-autofix audit). Must run before the 2-arg rule below. Rare GameText .Start().AddObject(alias) stays manual.

rules.name: ReplaceBuilder.AddObject(obj,alias) -> SetArgument(alias,obj)
rules.note: 2-arg aliased form (Object, Alias). Same confidence lookbehind as the 3-arg rule (tightened 2026-08: dropped bare \\.Start\\( — Thread/History false positives). Unaliased .AddObject(x) stays manual. Cell/Inventory/Zone placement excluded by lookbehind.

rules.name: Extensions.Capitalize -> Translator.InitUpper
rules.note: Only the static/qualified form. Instance-style s.Capitalize() must become Translator.InitUpper(s) by hand (receiver moves into the arg list).

rules.name: ColorUtility.CapitalizeExceptFormatting -> Translator.InitUpper
rules.note: DISABLED 2026-08 unsafe-autofix audit: InitUpper is NOT color-code-aware; auto-rewrite can regress formatted strings (CapitalizeExceptFormatting skips &K/{{…}} runs). Prefer hand-migrate to Translator.InitUpper only when no mid-string color codes, or keep CapitalizeExceptFormatting until a true replacement exists. Dump remains needsManual.

rules.name: HistoricEvent.hasEventProperty -> HasEventProperty
rules.note: DISABLED 2026-08 unsafe-autofix audit: bare .hasEventProperty( over-matches any type; dump already needsManual/autoFixable:false. Re-enable only with a HistoricEvent-receiver-gated pattern after reviewing call sites.

rules.name: HistoricEvent.setEventProperty -> SetEventProperty
rules.note: DISABLED 2026-08 unsafe-autofix audit: bare .setEventProperty( over-matches; dump needsManual. Same as hasEventProperty.

rules.name: HistoricEvent.getEventProperty -> GetEventProperty
rules.note: DISABLED 2026-08 unsafe-autofix audit: bare .getEventProperty( over-matches; dump needsManual.

rules.name: History.GetNewEntity -> CreateEntity
rules.note: DISABLED 2026-08 unsafe-autofix audit: bare .GetNewEntity( → .CreateEntity( can hit unrelated types; dump needsManual/autoFixable:false. Re-enable with History-receiver gate after reviewing call sites.

rules.name: StringBuilder local + AppendReputationDescription -> TextBuilder.Get
rules.note: DISABLED 2026-08: previous multi-line backref regex ReDoS-hung on any empty `new StringBuilder()`/`new()` (even without AppendReputationDescription). Logic moved to AppendReputationDescriptionFixer (Core + Update-ObsoleteApis Repair-ProgrammaticCsFixes).

rules.name: Dual_Wield_Fussilade -> Multiweapon_Flurry
rules.note: From Compat.xml skill rename; Dual Wield tree became Multiweapon Fighting. Word-boundary safe for XML/C# skill Name/Class/Prereq tokens.

rules.name: Dual_Wield_Ambidexterity -> Multiweapon_Expertise
rules.note: From Compat.xml skill rename (Dual Wield → Multiweapon Fighting tree).

rules.name: Dual_Wield_Offhand_Strikes -> Multiweapon_Proficiency
rules.note: From Compat.xml skill rename (Dual Wield → Multiweapon Fighting tree).

rules.name: Dual_Wield_Two_Weapon_Fighting -> Multiweapon_Mastery
rules.note: From Compat.xml skill rename (Dual Wield → Multiweapon Fighting tree).

rules.name: Dual_Wield -> Multiweapon_Fighting
rules.note: From Compat.xml skill rename. \b is safe vs Dual_Wield_* children because _ is a word char (no boundary before the suffix).

rules.name: builders GritGateWares+Tier2Wares -> MafeoWares restocker
rules.note: Vanilla Mafeo replaced the old GritGateWares+Tier2Wares builder pair with MafeoWares (includes Tier2Wares). Must run before the Tier2Wares 1:1 rule; consecutive-pair only. GritGateWares alone has no population — left for manual review.

rules.name: builder *Wares -> GenericInventoryRestocker (1:1 table)
rules.note: Old merchant ObjectBuilders (*Wares) were removed; stock now comes from GenericInventoryRestocker + PopulationTables of the same name. Only tables that still exist 1:1.

rules.name: Laterality Middle -> Mid
rules.note: XRL.World.Capabilities.Laterality.GetCode: Middle is invalid; MID=32 token is Mid (vanilla Bodies.xml uses Laterality="Mid" / "Right Mid" / "Left Mid"). Scoped to Laterality=" so ThrownWeapon/Type Middle Hardpoint is untouched. Compounds Middle Right/Left become Mid Right/Left (same codes as Right Mid/Left Mid). Crown is not a laterality token — hand-map (often Upper); no autofix.

rules.name: Bodies Type=Flipper -> Fin
rules.note: Anatomy/Bodies.xml: Flipper is not a vanilla BodyPartType. Lateral swimming limbs use Fin (same slots as Fish). Covers Type="Flipper" on <part> and <bodyparttype>.

rules.name: populations population/group/object/table name= -> Name=
rules.note: PopulationManager / XmlDataHelper case-sensitive Name=. Prefer PopulationXmlFixer for full wrong-case + Load value title-case; this curated rule covers the common lowercase name= form for dry-run visibility.

rules.name: populations population/group load= -> Load=
rules.note: Case-sensitive Load=; value title-cased by follow-up Load="merge"→Merge rules / PopulationXmlFixer.

rules.name: populations Load="merge" -> Load="Merge"
rules.note: PopulationItem Load == "Merge" is case-sensitive.

rules.name: populations Load='merge' -> Load='Merge'
rules.note: Single-quote variant of Load merge→Merge.

rules.name: populations Load="replace" -> Load="Replace"
rules.note: PopulationItem Load == "Replace" is case-sensitive.

rules.name: populations Load="remove" -> Load="Remove"
rules.note: PopulationItem Load == "Remove" is case-sensitive.

rules.name: populations population/group style= -> Style=
